name: Metabase
description: Open source business intelligence and analytics platform. Create dashboards and explore data without writing SQL.
summary: Metabase is actively releasing patch updates across multiple supported version branches simultaneously. The latest release is v0.62.3 (open source) / v1.62.3 (enterprise), released on June 24, 2025, alongside concurrent patches for v0.61.6, v0.60.11, v0.59.15, and v0.58.18. Both open source and enterprise editions are available as Docker images and JAR downloads. Detailed changelogs are linked per release at https://github.com/metabase/metabase/releases.

answers.What is the current license?: Dual: Open Source (AGPL v3 for OSS edition) and commercial Enterprise license
answers.Is the project actively maintained?: Yes — multiple patch releases across several version branches on June 24, 2025
answers.Is there a cloud-hosted version availabl: Yes — Metabase Cloud (managed cloud) is available at https://www.metabase.com
answers.Does it support SSO and SAML authenticat: Yes — SSO and SAML are supported in the Enterprise edition
answers.What databases/data sources are supporte: PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, SQL Server, SQLite, BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift, Spark SQL, MongoDB, Druid, Oracle, Presto/Trino, Athena, and more via drivers

alternatives.name: Redash
alternatives.review: Open source, query-focused, simpler feature set.

alternatives.name: Apache Superset
alternatives.review: Apache-licensed, rich visualisation library, steeper setup curve.

alternatives.name: Grafana
alternatives.review: Primarily metrics/time-series but increasingly used for general BI.

alternatives.name: Hex
alternatives.review: Close source, enterprise focus, AI Analytics Platform for your whole team

alternatives.name: Tableau
alternatives.review: Industry-leading visualization and analytics capabilities but is proprietary, expensive, and lacks the open-source self-hosted flexibility of Metabase.

alternatives.name: Lightdash
alternatives.review: Open-source BI tool tightly integrated with dbt that offers a more modern metrics layer approach but requires dbt adoption unlike Metabase.
